title: queue add --from queues a finding a check marked MET
what: `relay queue add --from <report.json> F<n>` refuses a finding that a later check record of the same branch marks MET, naming the check and its commit.
why: 28 Oct: base-restores-only-four-keys-bench-s-relay-claud was built for nothing (4 agents, 7 min, a lane): master had fixed it on 25 Oct in 58d5d5f9, and the item exists only because `relay queue add --from <report> F<n>` queued a finding that a check had marked MET two minutes earlier (found by the review of that empty branch).
failing_case: A review report with F1 and a check record marking F1 MET: `relay queue add --from review.json F1` queues it.
pass_cases: The same refuses and names the check.
A finding marked NOT MET or not checked is still queued.

fact: Seen again 30 Oct 2026: the review finding F1 of wt/bin-wt-new-queue-x (the bin/wt template), already MET in its check and fixed on master in c77fba2a, was queued with add --from as the-bin-wt-template-that-relay-setup-writes-into; a whole cycle (4 agents) built nothing; closed with done --fixed-by c77fba2a.
